Stockholm |country=Sweden |organizer={{Player|Lornelin|flag=se}} |admin={{Player|Zalon|flag=dk}} |Employees=Handful volunteers |sponsor=Game Evolution |Events= |website=qhlan.org |website2=pics.qhlan.org/qhlan/ }} '''QHLAN 13''' took place between 2nd - 6th of January [[2010]], in [https://maps.app.goo.gl/gjt61yBcoixHxtw4A Arlandagymnasiet], Stockholm, Sweden. This was the second [[QHLAN]] held in cooparation with GEv. QHLAN13 stands out as the only QHLAN where no official [[4on4]] tournament was held.
